name: Capability and outcome definition
scope: Capability Instance, Service Outcomes, tolerances, criticality and decision question are defined, owned and approved
failCeiling: INCONCLUSIVE for the whole decision: the top claim cannot be framed. The assessment returns to planning (AIDCF-009 DT-02) and no outcome-level decision is issued.
unknownCeiling: INCONCLUSIVE for each Service Outcome whose definition or tolerance is UNKNOWN (US5); the remaining outcomes are capped at LIMITED.
approvedNaConditions: Never. Every assessment has a Capability Instance and decision question.

name: Boundary and architecture integrity
scope: Assessment boundary, current architecture, as-built reconciliation and exclusions
failCeiling: If the boundary itself cannot be established: INCONCLUSIVE for the whole decision. If reconciliation demonstrates material divergence in part of the architecture: NOT_ASSURED for claims about the unreconciled systems and LIMITED for the decision as a whole.
unknownCeiling: LIMITED. Claims about systems whose reconciliation is incomplete are restricted to the DESIGN claim type.

name: Critical dependency visibility
scope: Material internal and external dependencies, common-mode exposure and concentration are identified and owned
failCeiling: NOT_ASSURED for every Service Outcome whose redundancy or independence claim is defeated by the identified common mode; LIMITED for the decision as a whole.
unknownCeiling: LIMITED. RESILIENCE claims for the affected outcomes are INCONCLUSIVE.

name: Life safety and hazardous energy
scope: Fire, electrical arc-flash and shock, hazardous fluids and chemicals, confined space, refrigerants, battery thermal runaway and safe work
failCeiling: NOT_ASSURED for any claim relying on the affected area; all hazardous testing in the affected area is suspended; the duty holder is notified immediately (outside the decision process); LIMITED for the decision as a whole.
unknownCeiling: LIMITED for outcomes depending on the affected area. No hazardous test is authorised there until the gate is resolved, so EFFECTIVENESS and RESILIENCE claims that need such tests remain UNKNOWN.
approvedNaConditions: Only when no physical infrastructure and no site activity lies within the boundary (for example a desk-based review of a logical platform whose facility is an external dependency under CG-03); approved by the decision owner with rationale.

name: Resilient electrical supply
scope: Utility, distribution, UPS/BESS, generation, fuel, protection and power quality sufficient for the Service Outcomes across operating states
failCeiling: NOT_ASSURED for every Service Outcome depending on the affected electrical path; LIMITED for the decision as a whole where unaffected paths remain.
unknownCeiling: LIMITED for outcomes depending on electrical continuity; RESILIENCE claims depending on the affected path are INCONCLUSIVE.
approvedNaConditions: Only when the entire electrical supply up to and including the rack power interface is outside the boundary and provided under a contract evaluated as an external dependency under CG-03 with evidence rights (for example a colocation tenant assessing its compute only). CG-03 shall then be PASS for that dependency.

name: Thermal continuity
scope: Heat-removal path (air, liquid, facility water, heat rejection) sufficient across operating states including transients
failCeiling: NOT_ASSURED for Service Outcomes served by the affected heat-removal path at the declared load.
unknownCeiling: LIMITED for outcomes depending on the affected heat-removal path.
approvedNaConditions: Only when the entire heat-removal path, including any in-rack and CDU elements, is outside the boundary and evaluated as an external dependency under CG-03 (for example an air-cooled tenant in a provider-managed facility).

name: Critical control-system integrity
scope: BMS, EPMS, CDU, PLC/SCADA and automation function safely, fail safe, and are configured and governed
failCeiling: NOT_ASSURED for Service Outcomes depending on the affected automated function. Claims based on demonstrated manual operation may be assessed separately and support at most LIMITED.
unknownCeiling: LIMITED for outcomes depending on the affected automation.
approvedNaConditions: Only if no automated control system within the boundary can change the state of in-scope power, cooling or life-safety systems, demonstrated as a negative claim (AIDCF-008 §29).

name: Compute, storage and network functional integrity
scope: Accelerators, storage and fabrics deliver the required function, performance and integrity
failCeiling: NOT_ASSURED for Service Outcomes delivered by the affected cluster, fabric or storage tier. Facility outcomes defined at the rack interface are unaffected.
unknownCeiling: LIMITED for the Service Outcomes delivered by the affected cluster, fabric or storage tier.
approvedNaConditions: Only for facility-only assessments in which Service Outcomes are defined at the facility interface (power and heat removal delivered to the rack) and no compute, storage or network is within the boundary.

name: Failure containment
scope: Fault domains, isolation and blast-radius limits prevent propagation beyond tolerance
failCeiling: NOT_ASSURED for RESILIENCE claims, and for any Service Outcome whose tolerance assumes the defeated containment; LIMITED for the decision as a whole.
unknownCeiling: INCONCLUSIVE for RESILIENCE claims of the affected outcomes; LIMITED for the decision as a whole.

name: Recovery readiness
scope: Restoration of outcomes (power, cooling, compute, data and checkpoint, network, control plane) within tolerance is planned and tested
failCeiling: NOT_ASSURED for recovery outcomes and for RESILIENCE claims of the affected outcomes; LIMITED for the decision as a whole.
unknownCeiling: LIMITED; recovery outcomes are INCONCLUSIVE. DESIGN claims about recovery may still be reported.
approvedNaConditions: Not permitted where any Service Outcome in the decision question declares a recovery tolerance or the target Assurance Level is AL4 or higher; otherwise only with approved rationale.

name: Evidence sufficiency
scope: Evidence for decisive claims meets the AIDCF-008 floors (meta-gate across all controls)
failCeiling: INCONCLUSIVE for the whole decision. Any previously issued decision relying on the affected evidence is SUSPENDED, and the matter is escalated as an evidence nonconformance (AIDCF-008 §47).

name: Critical UNKNOWN
scope: No unresolved US4 or US5 UNKNOWN without disposition (meta-gate across all controls)
failCeiling: INCONCLUSIVE for the whole decision; escalated as an evidence nonconformance (concealed UNKNOWN, AIDCF-008 §47).
unknownCeiling: LIMITED; INCONCLUSIVE if any undispositioned UNKNOWN is US5.

name: Responsibility and authority
scope: Every critical function and dependency has an accountable owner and decision authority
failCeiling: NOT_ASSURED for OPERATION, EFFECTIVENESS and RESILIENCE claims about the unowned function or dependency; LIMITED for the decision as a whole. If GC-13-6 is not met, no decision advances beyond the RECOMMENDED lifecycle state.

name: Change control
scope: Material changes are controlled, impact-assessed and validated
failCeiling: Affected evidence is invalidated (STALE, U3) and claims relying on the post-change state become UNKNOWN; any prior decision covering the affected scope is SUSPENDED; LIMITED for the decision as a whole, or NOT_ASSURED where the uncontrolled change is demonstrated to have defeated a safeguard.

name: Integrated digital authority over infrastructure
scope: Identity, privilege, remote access and control-plane reach over facility and AI infrastructure are bounded, monitored and recoverable
failCeiling: NOT_ASSURED for every Service Outcome reachable through the unbounded authority path; LIMITED for the decision as a whole.
unknownCeiling: LIMITED; INCONCLUSIVE where the unverified authority reaches the scope of two or more other gates (US5).
approvedNaConditions: Only if discovery demonstrates that no digital path (network, remote access, out-of-band, removable media or vendor tool) exists from any identity to in-scope control functions, recorded as a negative claim (AIDCF-008 §29).
